name: FAM latency pipeline (Exa to Chatterbox Turbo)
queries: Why are founder CEOs becoming harder for boards to remove?

notes: The target: query -> Exa -> Claude streaming -> first 25-word sentence-boundary chunk -> Chatterbox Turbo -> first playable audio, against the current production stack. Every stage is reported separately and the headline is time to first audio. The Chatterbox arm needs a running GPU endpoint; without one the engine stops before spending. Swap tts to chatterbox_local to run Turbo in-process on a machine that already has a card.
